Package com.goodbird.npcgecko.api

Interface IGeckoAnimatable

  • public interface IGeckoAnimatable
    Interface for accessing and modifying Gecko model configuration on NPCs and scripted blocks. Provides control over model, texture, animation files, and animation names for each state.

    Obtain via AbstractGeckoAPI.getAnimatable(noppes.npcs.api.entity.ICustomNpc) or AbstractGeckoAPI.getAnimatable(noppes.npcs.api.block.IBlockScripted).
